title: Microsoft Copilot Studio: Agent Sharing amongst makers
description: Enables sharing of agents with other makers in the new Microsoft Copilot harness. Makers can grant other makers Agent Viewer (view analytics/evaluations only) or Editor (view, edit, configure, share, publish) access to an agent, with auto-assigned security roles.
